State 0 is the empty cell (black)
State 1 is the cell (white)

Rules

Centre of attention: occupied cell
- Rule number one specifies the minimum number of adjacent cells to remain in state 1
- Rule number two specifies the maximum number of adjacent cells above which a cells state becomes 0

Centre of attention: empty cell
- Rule number three specifies the minimum number of adjacent cells required for birth
- Rule number four specifies the maximum number of adjacent cells required for birth
